A [[Carosite]] '''physician''' worked on the [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] ''[[Sudden Restoration]]'' during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] was blackmailed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to place [[Coma/Legends|comatose]] patients into coffins and blast them off into [[Realspace/Legends|space]], where they would be retrieved by Imperial [[Starship/Legends|ships]] for interrogation.
